edition.locus: Baehrens GCS 30 Iesu Nave Hom. I 4

source_text: Iesus Dominus et Salvator meus suscepit principatum. Cum Moyses educeret de Aegypto, nullus ordo; transeunt aquam maris salsam, murus aqua dextra laevaque. Cum Dominus meus ducit: sacerdotes praecedunt, arca Testamenti portatur; non mare sed Iordanen — cum sacerdotibus arcam portantibus, in tubarum cantibus. Qui venit solvere medium parietem saepis fecit utraque unum. Praeparate vobis cibos ad viam — opera velut viaticum. Transactis ripis desinit manna. Primi fructus: de regione palmarum et azyma. Mittit Iesus exploratores; hospitio suscipiuntur a meretrice — anima quae meretrix fuit donec in carnis cupiditatibus viveret.
pass_a_gloss: Jesus Lord and Savior my took principate. When Moses was-leading from Egypt, no order; they-cross water of-sea salty, wall was water right left. When Lord my leads: priests go-before, ark of-Testament is-carried; not sea but Jordan — with priests ark carrying, in of-trumpets songs. Who came to-dissolve middle wall of-fence made both one. Prepare for-yourselves foods for way — works as provision. With-banks-crossed ceases manna. First fruits: from region of-palms and unleavened. Sends Jesus spies; with-hospitality they-are-received by harlot — soul which harlot was while in of-flesh desires it-was-living.
pass_b_english: Jesus my Lord and Savior has taken the principate. Compare Moses’ deeds with Jesus’ rule. When Moses led Israel from Egypt there was no order in the people, no observance among the priests; they crossed [[the salt sea with a wall of water on right and left >> Bible:Exodus 14:22]]. When my Lord leads: [[priests go before, the ark of the covenant is borne >> Bible:Joshua 3:6]]; not the sea but the Jordan — not in panicked flight but with priests shouldering the ark, with trumpets sounding a heavenly mystery. He who [[came to break down the middle wall of partition made both one >> Bible:Ephesians 2:14]]: one part of the water stood, the other flowed to the sea. [[Prepare food for the journey >> Bible:Joshua 1:11]] — works that accompany us as faithful provision for the way ahead. Once we cross, [[manna ceases >> Bible:Joshua 5:12]]; whoever has not prepared food cannot follow Jesus into the land of promise. First fruits in the land: [[from the region of palms, and unleavened bread >> Bible:Joshua 5:11]] — the palm of victory, and, [[casting out the leaven of malice, the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth >> Bible:1 Corinthians 5:8]]. Jesus sends spies to Jericho’s king; a harlot receives them — each soul was a harlot while it lived in fleshly desires; it receives [[the angels he sent before his face to prepare his way >> Bible:Mark 1:2]], and lodges them not in low places but on high.
